verdicts.adopt-source-reused: the join variant caught (fired 98, changed 72, the fork loop failing); the loaded-ignores-done variant fired 108, changed nothing: prediction not met

findings: load-reuse-unwaited: the late copy has to still be in flight when its units' next writer runs and that writer's step may not wait on any later load (a launch waiting on one drains the copy stream in order). With copies at most 2 launches late (the CPU default) or 0.05-0.5 s sleeps (the GPU), the copy has landed by the abort or is drained; deferred up to 8 launches with answers long enough to read the reused pages back, it is caught, in the plain loop as well.

adopt-source-reused (loaded ignoring the reading step's end): a store must reuse the adopted host unit while the adopting step still runs; the adopted copy is the payload level's most recent (the load and hit move it to the end), so floor-many other payload stores would have to land within that step. Open.

the null test at a state memory too small for 16 checkpoint units compares different KV pools (the ledger gives paged state what the checkpoint pool does not take); it now refuses when cached_tokens differ, as invariance does, and reports the paged pools.
the runs ran on the working tree before std.state_tier's clear() also cleared hits (flush_prefix only; no run here flushes).
